title: Motorcycle Stability Analysis of the Bajaj Pulsar 150
summary: Built a 4-DOF lumped-parameter stability model of an Indian 150 cc commuter motorcycle, with lagging tyre forces and gyroscopic wheels, and validated it against a published bicycle benchmark to six significant figures. With a 70 kg rider it balances itself from 24 to 121 km/h, and handlebar wobble sets in just 5.7 km/h above its 115 km/h top speed.
context: Course project, Design of Automotive Systems, IISc
coverAlt: Real part of the weave, wobble and capsize eigenvalues against speed for the Pulsar 150, with the self-stable band from 24 to 121 km/h shaded and the 115 km/h top speed marked.
